# Orbit by coolLabs

Orbit is an open-source workspace for teams: tasks, docs and chat in one app. Self-host free, or Orbit Cloud at $10 per workspace each month with unlimited members.

## Product
- [Orbit](https://orbit.so/)
- [Pricing](https://orbit.so/pricing)

## Buyer guides
- [Linear, Notion and Slack alternative](https://orbit.so/linear-notion-slack-alternative)
- [Flat-price team workspace](https://orbit.so/flat-price-team-workspace)
- [Self-hosted workspace with MCP](https://orbit.so/self-hosted-workspace-mcp)
- [Huly alternative](https://orbit.so/huly-alternative)
